priorityList: Use Vampiric Blood if it is not currently active.
Use Death Strike if the Coagulopathy buff is about to expire (within 1 GCD).
Use Dancing Rune Weapon only if you do not currently have the Exterminate buff or the Reaper's Mark debuff active.
Use Death Strike if Runic Power is nearly capped (deficit less than 20, or less than 26 during Dancing Rune Weapon).
Cast Death and Decay if you do not currently have the Death and Decay buff active.
Use Marrowrend when the Exterminate buff is active.
Use Death's Caress to maintain Bone Shield (if below 6 stacks or 3 seconds remaining) when you have fewer than 4 Runes available.
Use Marrowrend to maintain Bone Shield (if below 6 stacks or 3 seconds remaining).
Use Death Strike as your primary Runic Power spender.
Use Blood Boil as a filler for damage and threat.
Use Consumption while Dancing Rune Weapon is not active.
Use Heart Strike as your primary Rune spender.
Use offensive Trinkets and Racials if Dancing Rune Weapon is on cooldown for more than 78 seconds or the fight is nearly over.
